answer_text:
# 📊 Grade to Percentage Calculator

Here is a comprehensive guide to converting grades to percentages, along with the formulas and scales you need!

---

## 🔢 Basic Formula: Score to Percentage

Use the following formula:

**Percentage Score = 100 × (Total Points − Wrong Answers) ÷ Total Points**

**Example:**
If a student answers 40 questions and gets 7 wrong:
`Percentage = 100 × (40 - 7) / 40 = **82.5%`**, which corresponds to a **B-** on the default grading scale.

---

## 🔡 Standard US Letter Grade to Percentage Scale

Below is the standard grading system used in US schools and universities. However, grading may vary among schools, classes, and teachers.

| Letter Grade | Percentage Range | GPA (4.0 Scale) |
|---|---|---|
| A+ | 97–100% | 4.0 |
| A | 93–96% | 4.0 |
| A- | 90–92% | 3.7 |
| B+ | 87–89% | 3.3 |
| B | 83–86% | 3.0 |
| B- | 80–82% | 2.7 |
| C+ | 77–79% | 2.3 |
| C | 73–76% | 2.0 |
| C- | 70–72% | 1.7 |
| D+ | 67–69% | 1.3 |
| D | 63–66% | 1.0 |
| D- | 60–62% | 0.7 |
| F | Below 60% | 0.0 |

---

## ⚖️ Weighted Grade Formula

If your course has multiple components (homework, quizzes, exams) with different weights:

**Weighted Grade = w₁×g₁ + w₂×g₂ + w₃×g₃ + ...**
(where **w** = weight in % and **g** = grade)

**Example:**

- Math: grade 80, weight 30%
- Biology: grade 90, weight 50%
- History: grade 72, weight 20%

**Weighted Grade = 30%×80 + 50%×90 + 20%×72 = 83.4%**

---

## 🎯 Final Exam Grade Formula

If you want to know what score you need on your final exam to achieve a target grade:

**Grade Needed on Final = (Target Grade − Current Grade × (100% − Weight of Final Exam)) ÷ Weight of Final Exam**

**Example:**
If you currently have a B (85%), want an A- (90%) overall, and the final is worth 20% of your grade, you can use this formula to calculate the required final score.

---

|---|---|
| [Calculator.net](https://www.calculator.net/grade-calculator.html) | Finding the grade needed on a final exam; accepts letter grades, percentage grades, and other numerical inputs. |
| [RapidTables](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/grade/test-grade-calculator.html) | Percentage grades, letter grades, and point grade calculations. |
| [OmniCalculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/other/test-grade) | Quickly determining test percentage score and grade. |
| [Grade-Assistant.com](https://grade-assistant.com/calculator/ez-grade) | Teachers inputting number of questions and wrong answers to determine percentage score and letter grade or GPA. |

---

> 💡 **Tip:** Always check which grading system is used in your case. Sometimes the passing score border is not 60%, but could be 50% or 65%.
